pick.title: Choose a swing
pick.body: Open a result in History and tap Swing Lab, or look at your patterns.
hb_note: Body lines cannot be seen from this camera position; use face-on or down-the-line.
pick.lead: Choose a swing to see the alignment lines, the eight phases and the faults the rules can see.
replay.title: Replay and lines
step.none: No fault of this swing is marked on the timeline
lines.title: Alignment lines
lines.hint: Lines are taken at address; with “Also draw the current frame” on, a line that moves away from address turns to the caution colour. Lines are a guide, not a measurement.
lines.not_here: Lines not drawn from this camera position ({n})
faults.title: What the rules see
faults.none: With the current rules, no fault was seen in this swing
faults.unknown: Cannot tell from this view or this clip ({n})
faults.note: The thresholds are common teaching rules of thumb: unverified and not fitted to you. Each fault is only judged from a camera position that can see it. “Possible” means the error range crosses the threshold.
sensitivity.label: Sensitivity
sensitivity.hint: Relaxed: every threshold is half again as wide, so only clearer faults show
detail.note: The number is estimated from the pose in the video and has an error range; the threshold is an unverified rule of thumb.
phases.title: Eight phases
phase.aria: {event}, {n} faults, tap to jump to this frame
drills.title: Practice
drills.none: Nothing to practise from this swing; more practice for this camera position below.
drill.check.below: Goal: at least {n} of your last {of} swings with “{metric}” below {v}
drill.check.above: Goal: at least {n} of your last {of} swings with “{metric}” above {v}
drill.check.between: Goal: at least {n} of your last {of} swings with “{metric}” between {lo} and {hi}
no_pose.title: No pose data saved for this swing
no_pose.body: Lines and the faults that need the pose cannot be shown; only the numbers already computed are judged.
drill.ee_wall.title: Hips on the wall
drill.ee_wall.goal: Keep the hips back in the downswing instead of pushing them toward the ball.
drill.ee_wall.steps:
Stand with your back to a wall, seat lightly touching it at address
Swing slowly to halfway back; the seat still touches the wall
At the impact position, the other side of the seat touches the wall
Make 10 practice swings, then hit balls
drill.ee_chair.title: Chair back
drill.ee_chair.goal: Use a chair back to feel where the hips are at impact.
drill.ee_chair.steps:
Put a chair behind you so its back just touches your seat
Hit half swings, keeping the seat on the chair back at impact
Make the swing longer step by step
drill.posture_hold.title: Hold your posture
drill.posture_hold.goal: Keep the forward bend of address through impact.
drill.posture_hold.steps:
At address, imagine the top of your head against a wall
Only let the upper body rise after impact
Hit 10 half swings and watch the head height change
drill.ott_pump.title: Pause in the downswing
drill.ott_pump.goal: Let the hands drop from the inside in the downswing instead of throwing them out.
drill.ott_pump.steps:
Swing to the top
Stop with the hands at hip height on the way down: hands under the shoulders, close to the body
Go back to the top and repeat; on the third time hit the ball
drill.ott_gate.title: Two-object gate
drill.ott_gate.goal: Swing the club head from the inside out.
drill.ott_gate.steps:
Put one object outside and ahead of the ball and one inside and behind it: a lane from inside to out
Hit half swings without touching either object
When that works, make the swing longer
drill.sway_wall.title: Trail foot by the wall
drill.sway_wall.goal: Turn the pelvis in place in the backswing instead of moving it back.
drill.sway_wall.steps:
Put the outside of your trail foot next to a wall or an upright club
In the backswing your hip must not touch it
Make 10 practice swings, then hit balls
drill.sway_feet.title: Feet together
drill.sway_feet.goal: Less side-to-side movement in the backswing.
drill.sway_feet.steps:
Stand with your feet together
Hit balls at two-thirds effort
Feel the body turn around the spine instead of moving sideways
drill.slide_post.title: Post by the lead foot
drill.slide_post.goal: Turn the pelvis toward the target in the downswing instead of sliding it.
drill.slide_post.steps:
Stand an upright club just outside the lead foot
In the downswing the pelvis must not touch it: turn it back instead
Make slow practice swings first, then hit balls
drill.spine_stack.title: Check the top
drill.spine_stack.goal: Keep the upper body from leaning toward the target at the top.
drill.spine_stack.steps:
Swing to the top and stop
Check that the trail shoulder is lower than the lead one and the head has not moved toward the target
Hold for 2 seconds, then swing down
drill.dip_level.title: Head height
drill.dip_level.goal: Keep the head from dropping at impact.
drill.dip_level.steps:
Note your head height at address
Hit half swings feeling the head height stay the same
Ask a partner to hold a hand just above your head as a reminder
drill.rise_hold.title: Look up after impact
drill.rise_hold.goal: Do not stand up early at impact.
drill.rise_hold.steps:
After impact keep looking at where the ball was for one beat
Only stand up in the finish
Hit 10 balls and watch the head height change
drill.weight_step.title: Step drill
drill.weight_step.goal: Move the hips toward the target in the downswing, without passing the lead foot.
drill.weight_step.steps:
Address with the feet together
In the backswing step the lead foot toward the target
As it lands, swing down and hit, feeling the hips move over to the lead foot
drill.three_quarter.title: Three-quarter backswing
drill.three_quarter.goal: Stop the backswing before the shaft passes parallel.
drill.three_quarter.steps:
Stop the backswing when the lead arm is parallel to the ground
Hold the top for 1 second and check the shaft has not gone past parallel
Hit 10 balls with that length
drill.tempo_count.title: Count three to one
drill.tempo_count.goal: Bring the backswing-to-downswing time close to 3 to 1.
drill.tempo_count.steps:
Count “one, two, three” in the backswing
Count “four” in the downswing
Practise without a ball, then hit balls and watch the ratio
drill.tempo_pause.title: Pause at the top
drill.tempo_pause.goal: Do not rush down from the top.
drill.tempo_pause.steps:
Swing to the top
Pause for half a beat
Then swing down smoothly and hit
what.early_extension: The pelvis moves toward the ball from address to impact, leaving less room for the arms.
what.loss_of_posture: At impact the upper body bends forward much less than at address: standing up early.
what.over_the_top: With the lead arm level in the downswing, the hands are higher and further out than at the same point of the backswing: the club comes in from outside.
what.sway: In the backswing the pelvis moves away from the target instead of turning in place.
what.slide: In the downswing the pelvis slides toward the target past the line of the lead ankle.
what.reverse_spine: At the top the upper body leans toward the target.
what.head_dip: At impact the head is much lower than at address.
what.early_rise: At impact the head is much higher than at address: rising early.
what.weight_back: At impact the pelvis has not moved toward the target from where it was at address. This measures pelvis position, not how weight is spread under the feet.
what.overswing: At the top the shaft goes past parallel.
what.tempo_off: The backswing-to-downswing time is far from the usual 3 to 1.
drill.check.clear: Goal: at least {n} of your last {of} swings without “{fault}”
